description: Plays a column of numbers from a CSV file: each trigger steps to the next value in the column and puts it out as three voltages and a gate

params.text: Sets how many octaves the V/OCT output spans, 1 to 8; from 1 to 3 octaves the span rises from 0V, and from 4 octaves up the top of the span is fixed at +4V and the extra octaves are added below it
Sets how long the gate is held high for each value played, from 1ms to 1 second

inputs.text: A trigger here plays the next value in the column, moving the three voltage outputs to it and firing a gate
A trigger here returns the playhead to the first value without playing it; the voltage outputs hold what they had, and the next trigger at TRIG plays that first value

outputs.text: A 10ms trigger fired as the last value in the column plays; patched back to RESET it loops the data with no gap
The value played, scaled so that the smallest number in the column gives -5V and the largest gives +5V
The value played, scaled so that the smallest number in the column gives 0V and the largest gives 10V
The value played as a pitch, scaled across the octave span set by RANGE
A 10V gate for each value played, held for the time set by LENGTH; a missing value in the column fires no gate

notes: a new module is loaded with a built-in series of 64 yearly global temperature figures, so it plays something before any file is chosen
to play your own numbers, right-click and choose Load CSV, then right-click again and choose a column from the list at the foot of the menu
the file needs one header row of column names, and only columns with at least one number in them can be chosen; the rest are greyed out in the menu
a blank or non-numeric cell becomes a gap: that step fires no gate and the voltage outputs hold their last value, so it is heard as a silence
nothing advances without a trigger at TRIG; the module has no clock of its own
hovering the chart highlights the value under the cursor, and a left-click cues it, so the next trigger plays that value and play carries on from there
a right-click on the chart opens the module's menu rather than cueing anything
a hollow circle on the chart marks the value cued to play next, and a filled circle marks the one most recently played
with no reset patched the circle disappears once the playhead has run past the last value, and nothing plays until a reset arrives
the chosen column is saved inside the patch, up to 10000 values, so the patch plays even where the file has been moved or deleted
while the patch is playing that saved copy, the column list and the delimiter choice cannot be changed until a reload from disk succeeds
the chart prints CSV file not found where the file has gone, and Invalid CSV where the file is there but cannot be read as data; while either is shown the module produces nothing at all
menu: Load CSV — opens a file browser for a csv, tsv or txt file and selects the first column in it that holds numbers
Reload CSV from disk — reads the file again, keeping the chosen column by matching its name, so an edit to the file is picked up; it is offered once a file has been loaded
Delimiter: Detect automatically, Comma, Tab, Semicolon, Custom — sets the character that separates the columns and reads the file again with it, which gives a different set of columns
Detect automatically — counts commas, tabs, semicolons and pipes in the first line of the file and takes the commonest as the separator; it is in the Delimiter submenu
Custom character, then Enter: — a box in the Delimiter submenu taking any single character as the separator, applied when you press Enter
